svg.title: GL2 cocharacters and PGL2 degree parity

cc:Work.dc:title: GL2 cocharacters and PGL2 degree parity
cc:Work.dc:description: Integer pairs -2 through 2 labelled by a+b. The coroot step (1,-1) preserves degree. The central step (1,1) shifts degree by 2. Degrees -4 through 4 have even and odd parity.
